head: akṣobhya
target: mi bskyod pa ste zhal gyi pad+ma sprin dang pa la 'od ldan ri bong can rnams rgya mtsho mtshungs/ / dbus dang g.yas dang g.yon rnams sngon po dmar po dkar po rnams dang ldan pa'i mgrin gsum pa/ / g.yon gyi dpung pa'i rim bzhin dkar min dmar dang dkar ba rnams te g.yas pa'i dpung pa gsum/ /
src_sentence: akṣobhyo ghanabhānuhemaśaśabhṛdvarṇārṇavāsyāmbuja- mantardakṣiṇavāmanīlarudhiraśvetātrakaṇṭhatrayam tadvarṇaṃ vāme'tha kramato'sitāruṇasitaṃ skandhatrayaṃ dakṣiṇe yugalatrayaṃ bhagavataḥ pāśe catuṣkatrayam aṅgulyaḥ karakendubhānujaladaśyāmāśca vṛddhādikā- stāsāmantimamadhyamādhamasudhāsūryātraparvatrayam śuṣkaiḥ śreṇīśca śirasi śiraḥ pañcakaiḥ pañcavarṇaiḥ kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhī kaṭivinihitā mekhalā kuṇḍalaṃ tu karṇe pāṇau mūrdhanyapi paṭṭo ||

head: akṣobhya
target: de ni rgyal ba mi bskyod pa ste don grub rgyal ba nor bu'i phyag ldan de nyid kyis/ / chu skyes phyag ldan de nyid 'khor lo can no yang ni de yi rgyal ba rnam par shes/ / spyi bo la gnas sgrib pa bral ba so so'i phyag rgya mdzad la dang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /
src_sentence: akṣobhyasya jinasya mudraṇapatiḥ śrīvajrasattvo jina: tasyākṣobhyajino jino maṇikaro'moghasya tasyābjadhṛk cakrī tasya ca tasya mudraṇapatirvijñānaśuddhā jinā etān mauligatānnamāmi vinato bhikṣūn svamudrādharān ||51||
